question: Which concurrency and batch setting improves task latency without failing correctness?
target_population: Fixture tasks; production transfer requires new representative tasks

objectives.name: latency_ms
objectives.measurement_method: Elapsed monotonic time after fixed warmup
objectives.validity_evidence: Synthetic fixture only; known output and timer sensitivity checks

randomization: Randomize cells with recorded seed; pair arms on each task
blocking: Block by task; keep machine and provider version fixed
stopping_rule: Fixed budget; no repeated significance peeking
guard: All correctness checks pass; failed or absent guard blocks promotion
